external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues who sign in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who are vouched for by their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: franchise stores
external_entities.description: External franchise stores whose colleagues are allowed to sign in.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by the franchisees that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The HR system that supplies group membership changes and leaver information overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, consumes HR changes, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-ins, and writes sign-ins to the audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The text identifies it as one of the applications that takes the token.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues sign in through their own identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token containing the colleague's staff ID and group list.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: Tokens are good for twelve hours and there is no way to pull one back before it expires.

data_flows.name: administer stores
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console to change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.
data_flows.data_description: store-manager token and price or transaction administration

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: store signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps the token signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.notes: The same key signs the tokens for every application.

data_flows.name: sync groups
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group membership changes and leaver changes to the identity broker overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: This is also how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group membership information in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.notes: Group membership is supplied by the HR system overnight rather than maintained by hand.

data_flows.name: record sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is not documented what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home, which are controlled by another party than the corporate network.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment outside the organisation's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise identity provider
trust_boundaries.description: The identity-provider environment operated by the franchisees.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

assumptions.assumption: The directory's classification is confidential because it contains colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's classification is confidential because it holds a token signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store contains the signing key used to sign tokens.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's classification is confidential because it contains sign-in records associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
